Projectiles of people who are not hostil: Projectiles of people who are not hostile to each other (you and your follower) never clash.

The one that flies on loses the strength: The one that flies on loses the strength of what it beat.
Two lightning bolts (any one-shot bolt): Two lightning bolts (any one-shot bolt) that cross burst between the casters and both go. A fired bolt still counts for a moment after it fades, so they need not be cast in the same instant.
A destroyed projectile bursts where it w: A destroyed projectile bursts where it was hit, with its own explosion.
Skip a burst that would do more than sho: Skip a burst that would do more than show: damage, an enchantment, something it spawns. Spells' own explosions only show.

When enemy sprays, held beams or breath: When enemy sprays, held beams or breath meet, they lock together and push. Whoever has the higher magic skill drives the meeting point back and breaks through. Off: they clash particle by particle.
Sparks, Lightning Storm and other held b: Sparks, Lightning Storm and other held beams. A one-shot bolt never locks.
Fire and Frost Breath, yours or a dragon: Fire and Frost Breath, yours or a dragon's.
Casters whose hands are closer than this: Casters whose hands are closer than this do not lock. Enemies close right in during a fight, so keep it low. 70 units is about a metre.
Chance two casters lock when their strea: Chance two casters lock when their streams meet, rolled once each time. A miss: they clash particle by particle until one stops casting.
The same when one side is a dragon. 0: n: The same when one side is a dragon. 0: never with dragons.
When both cast from a school of magic, t: When both cast from a school of magic, the higher skill always pushes through. Level, magicka, spell and dual casting only change how fast. Breath is a plain contest of power.
How hard whoever struggles against you p: How hard whoever struggles against you pushes. Above 1 is harder.
When time runs out, whoever is ahead bre: When time runs out, whoever is ahead breaks through. Dead even: the spells burst and both are thrown off. 0: no limit.
The overwhelmed caster staggers, with th: The overwhelmed caster staggers, with the game's own stagger. Not dragons.
A breakthrough that kills throws the bod: A breakthrough that kills throws the body away from the winner. Experimental.
An extra hit on the overwhelmed caster,: An extra hit on the overwhelmed caster, about two seconds of the winning stream, less their resistance. 0: only the stream's own damage.
